column11: Incumbent: enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab (Padcev plus Keytruda). column12: JUDGEMENT: half of what the incumbent measurably captured in its first full year. The eligible pool is first-line-treated patients, the same denominator as this share. SGNDV-001 compares against chemotherapy, not EV+P, and EV+P is already standard in HER2-expressing patients, so DV must take share from Pfizer's own Padcev. Case for lower: no head-to-head against EV+P; nivolumab plus gemcitabine-cisplatin, the other new first-line regimen, reached only 4 of 935 first-line starts (0.4%) from April 2023 to September 2024 (Sonpavde et al., J Clin Oncol 2025;43(16 suppl):e16556, Flatiron); Pfizer's $1.6bn 2025 impairment on updated long-range forecasts. Case for higher: RC48-C016 matched EV-302's OS (31.5 months both) with a PFS hazard ratio of 0.36 against 0.45, and EV+P reached 62% of first-line starts in 2025 in the Ozay series. Check: 0.255 x 84,530 x 0.082338 = 1,775 starts a year, a plateau of about 3,780 US patients at 47% stopping
